title: Core: undo/redo history helpers
description: Add useHistory hook and pushDoc helper to packages/core/src/engine/ (or packages/authoring-ui if needed). The hook manages a documents[] stack + cursor. pushDoc(newDoc) adds to history. undo()/redo() move the cursor. Max history depth: 50. Return {doc, pushDoc, undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo}. Must be pure immutable logic. Shell.tsx already uses a pushDoc pattern — standardize it. Add unit tests.
